description: Navigate to the Reports section in HospitalRun and generate an 'Admissions Detail' report (or the 'Admissions' report). Configure the report date range to cover from January 1, 2015 to December 31, 2025 to ensure all historical data is included. Once the report is generated and data rows are visible on the screen, take a screenshot of the report and save it to '~/Desktop/admissions_report.png'.
